'''Sand bats''', also known as '''dragonbats''', were flying creatures that inhabited warm and temperate [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==History==
Sand bats were nocturnal hunters that used to hunt both alone or in small packs, but there were chances to see them gathering into massive "swarms". The swarm was a form of society, since the individuals were protected from threats thanks to the massive numbers and it helped the species to ensure genetic diversity while increasing the creatures' population. In a swarm the sand bats would fight to weed out weak members of the population as well as find mates. Another advantage for these beasts was that they could draw sustenance from carrion as well from fresh meat, making them adaptable to many environments. This fact made them a serious threat to [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] creatures that wandered their territory and a source of fear for fellow animals.<ref name="TOR" />

[[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] often dipped their [[Gaderffii/Legends|gaffi sticks]] in [[Sand bat venom/Legends|sand bat venom]], which was deadly to [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and was said to inflict excruciating pain. [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] was once injured by such an envenomed weapon, but [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] carried Biggs in his [[skyhopper]] to a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] before the venom overwhelmed his friend.<ref name="MC 17">[[Star Wars (1977) 17|''Star Wars'' (1977) 17]]</ref>
